profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cubic Corporation

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer - Cloud
positions.description:
•Managed Infrastructure as Code using Azure ARM Templates to deploy virtual machines to various application teams within Markel.
•Developed and codified Azure Policies to be deployed to various management groups; utilized Pester to unit test policies.
•Coordinated and collaborated with the DevOps team to migrate IaC and Policy deployments using Terraform on Jenkins.
•Performed various requests regarding but not limited to VNets, NSGs, RBACs, PIM, SPNs, Load Balancers, and Log Analytics.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
VCS21 - Voice Communication Systems for 21st Century (Jul '16 - Feb '18)
The VCS21 systems allows net-centric and legacy voice systems to coexist.  This enables a seamless transition during ATM modernization programs of virtually any size and complexity, from small, single-tower installations to national and multinational voice systems. The system also operates as a fully networked enterprise voice system, with enhanced capabilities for business continuity planning, asset sharing and future facilities.
• Reverse engineered the VCS21 system to help compose both CSC and CSCI software design documents.  Consisted of identifying use cases, key methods, and creating activity/sequence/use case diagrams.
• Composed user stories detailing instructions of proper shutdown and performance checking procedures of system components.
• Debugged priority defects present within the air-to-ground communication system.

GSR - Yorktown (Feb '18 - Present)
A $500 IDIQ contract with the NGA to develop a system designed to efficiently search for and retrieve data from intelligence systems.
• Created and updated IDOL connectors and harvesters used to parse record millions of volumes of records.  Docker containers were used to run these applications.
• Engineered many of the sub-components required for the Order Service application; entailing but not limited to integrating systems to use our image server, integrating our CMS (Credential Mapping Service), and supporting the Order Status REST Interface
• Maintained our Drupal site with updates and fixes to the status of our Content Stores
• Supported the Devops team with updated Jenkins procedures for every newly created and updated application.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
•Monitored food quality as well as usage of proper food safety procedures.
•Trained new members and upheld monthly staff meetings for performance and consistency.
•Directed operation of social media, marketing, designs, and menus.

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst
positions.description:
•Upheld maintenance of Windows Server 2008, two LANs, VoIP, SonicWall Firewall, and networking, our Konica Minolta machine.
•Troubleshot many computer related issues involving user related problems
•Deployed and Managed 200+ workstations for multiple law firms viewing confidential documents and redaction.
